title: Approximation of monic polynomials over a dense subfield
statement: Let $D\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], with $K$ a normed field. A normed field here means a field with a real-valued norm satisfying $\|z\|\geq0$, $\|z\|=0\Leftrightarrow z=0$, $\|1\|=1$, $\|zw\|=\|z\|\|w\|$ and $\|z+w\|\leq\|z\|+\|w\|$, with distance $d(z,w)=\|z-w\|$. Assume $D$ is dense in $K$, meaning that for every $z\in K$ and $r>0$ there is $u\in D$ with $\|z-u\|<r$. Let $f\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be monic (leading coefficient $1$), and let $\varepsilon>0$. There is a monic $g\in D[T]$ with $\deg g=\deg f$ such that $\|g_i-f_i\|<\varepsilon$ for every $i\geq0$, where $g_i$ is viewed in $K$ through $D\subseteq K$.
